decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">Location Plan, Design &amp; Access
Statement, 49BD(55) rev A, 49BD(54) rev B, 49BD(53) rev B, 49BD(52) rev A, 49BD(51)
rev A.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 107%;">Notwithstanding the details shown on the
approved plans, the development hereby approved shall not be first occupied
until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning
authority:</span></p><p>a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span>A
revised scheme of hard and soft landscaping works with the provision of &nbsp;&nbsp;enhanced soft landscaping to the front
forecourt, and at least 1 metre wide strips of planting to the front of Flat
49a’s ground floor front habitable room windows. The details shall include:
planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), and schedules of plants,
noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities, written
specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken, and a
landscape&nbsp; implementation programme;</p><p>b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span>A
scheme of hard landscaping works which shall include: material details, if
permeable materials are used full construction details of permeable paving and
their maintenance plan. If non permeable material is used, details regarding
management of surface water run-off from the proposed hardstanding.</p><p>c)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span>A
revised scheme of boundary treatment works, indicating the provision of 1.8m
high boundary treatment subdividing the private rear gardens of each flat, and
the provision of secure boundary treatment restricting the void to the side of
the building. Details shall be provided on the materials, colouring and height
of all proposed boundary treatment works, including new access gates.</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</p>

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

<p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span style="line-height: 107%;">Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby
permitted shall not be occupied until details of proposed cycle parking stores
have been submitted to, and approved in writing by the local planning
authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The submitted details
shall include proposed elevation details together with details of the proposed
external materials associated with the cycle stores, and the cycle stores shall
be indicated to be secure and lockable.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The development shall
be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed prior to the first
occupation of the development and shall be retained thereafter. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><br></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Other than when in
use, cycles shall be stored at all times within the designated areas detailed
on Drawing No. 49BD(53) rev B.<br></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development hereby permitted shall be used
for Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of the
Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015
(or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification),
no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.</span><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The development
hereby approved shall not be occupied until <span lang="EN-US" style="">a Fire Safety Statement </span>has<span lang="EN-US" style=""> b</span>een<span lang="EN-US" style=""> submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority,
this statement shall include details of how the development will function in
terms of the following:</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style=""><br></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;text-indent:
.55pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style=""><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">1) identify suitably positioned
unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b)
appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">2) is designed to incorporate
appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious
injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and
passive and active fire safety measures <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">3) is constructed in an appropriate way
to minimise the risk of fire spread <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">4) provide suitable and convenient
means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">5) develop a robust management strategy
for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of
how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be
included), and which all building users can have confidence in<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">6) provide suitable access and
equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the
development.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The development shall be operated in
accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>
description: Conversion of dwelling into two flats (2x3 bed), single and two storey rear extension rear dormer, external alterations, separate amenity space, bin and cycle stores
